name: Imperatriz

routes.outcome: Official municipal SEPLU page identifies the local urban-planning authority responsible for loteamentos and parcelamento de glebas/terrenos. Custodian/procedure evidence only; no parcel data endpoint.

Official municipal notice describes implementation of Cadastro Técnico Multifinalitário and georeferencing, including thematic maps and a broad view of properties. It does not publish a parcel API, safe parcel identity, or geometry.
Official 2026 IPTU notice references the municipal Cadastro Imobiliário Fiscal and taxpayer portal. It is fiscal/procedural evidence; no parcel geometry or parcel query was requested.

Official municipal procurement text describes cadastral modules including lots, blocks, fiscal sectors and georeferenced management. This evidences an internal/contracted system requirement, not an anonymous public API.

Official public map loaded. HTML and current JavaScript show a Google Maps institutional-points viewer with category/type/place filters; no cadastral parcel viewer or parcel layer configuration was present.
Current map JavaScript calls /mapa/busca and plots latitude/longitude markers with institution metadata. No WMS/WFS/GeoJSON parcel route, parcel schema, or parcel CRS was present.

Bounded anonymous response returned 82843 bytes of institutional point records with fields id, name, latitude, longitude, type, district and category. These are service-location records, not parcel identities or polygons; no geometry was retained.
Official INCRA page lists an Imperatriz advanced unit and rural cadastral/land responsibilities. It does not expose a public urban parcel layer or safe parcel geometry endpoint.

Official ITERMA SiCARF portal describes land regularization workflows. It requires land/process information and does not expose a public anonymous parcel geometry service; no login or personal/owner fields were requested.
Official IBGE municipal map is administrative/cartographic reference, not a cadastral parcel dataset. No parcel identity or polygon was retained.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Prefeitura map page and /static/scripts/map.js; institutional Google Maps marker viewer only.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Point coordinates returned as latitude/longitude decimal strings; no parcel CRS resolved.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Institutional point id observed, but it is not a parcel identity and was not mapped as one.
schemaAndCrs.sourceFieldMapping: Public map response fields observed: id/name/latitude/longitude/type/district/category/additional service metadata; not a parcel schema and no raw attribute set retained.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Public municipal map endpoint with no filters

localCustodianAssessment: Municipal SEPLU and the municipal Fazenda/Planning administration are evidenced as local custodians of urban planning and cadastral/fiscal systems. INCRA and ITERMA are general federal/state land agencies with Imperatriz coverage, but neither supplied a public parcel layer in these attempts.

qualification.reason: A municipal cadastral/urban-planning custodian is evidenced, but no anonymous public parcel identity/geometry service was qualified. Runtime adapter admission remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The municipal map endpoint's point response, map extent, and absence of a parcel route were not treated as citywide cadastral absence.
No full parcel polygon was returned, so no GeoJSON sample is retained.
Native source fields and composite-key provenance are documented here; no raw source-specific attribute set was retained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Request caches and qualification evidence are under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/5597/.
TLS verification remained enabled; no certificate exception was used.
No login, credential, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe field request was attempted.
uncertainty: Public parcel coverage, endpoint availability, parcel schema/CRS, update cadence, licensing, and runtime adapter behavior remain unresolved. registryFound=true records evidenced municipal custodians and cadastral procedures only; it does not imply public API access, source integration, or runtime admission.
